facts.text: Launched in December 2004 by Kevin Rose and partners.
Community voting pushed stories to the front page; a front-page hit could flatten smaller sites, the so-called Digg effect.
The August 2010 version 4 redesign triggered a user revolt and a mass exodus to rival Reddit.
Sold to Betaworks in July 2012 for a price reported at around half a million US dollars, a fraction of the venture capital it had raised.
